angle: START FROM THE PROGRAM'S OWN OBJECTS: THE TEST RECORD. The only test object this surface natively has is another record — a small one. The instrument reads how a weak probe record's OWN earned laws (its tunneling splitting, its lifetime tau from its own Liouvillian mode, its steady value) shift as a function of earned separation from distant written content, through a priced coupling, against the unwritten control.
name: THE SECOND LUMP
summary: Place the smallest record the surface admits — a hole-pair record (two removed stabilizers, C-80's own Bravyi-Kitaev defect construction, w_min = d_gen sealed in geometry.py coupling_cost) — at earned separation from a written hole-pair record of the dual type, with the program's alpha-type local coupling V = lam*sum_e Z_e as the declared mediator. The probe's own law is the reading: its doublet splitting Delta (and, at grounded tier, its lifetime tau via grounded.py lifetime()). The FIELD READING is F(D) = Delta(source written -1) - Delta(source written +1): the written-value differential of the probe's own law, in energy units, at a place where the written content is not. Mechanism (computed in a scratchpad exploration, sector-exact on toric 3x2): the source's record value multiplies the enclosure class of the probe's admissible writer sum — holonomy, the program's own claim vocabulary — giving F = -1.99e-3 at lam=0.05 contact and +1.94e-4 at the far placement, with onset order in lam equal to the earned enclosure cost (3.0 and 3.9 measured vs w_enc = 3 and 4), and the unwritten control identical to source-absent to machine precision. The shape of F vs separation is never assumed; at kernel tier it is classified against the surface's own three computed classes (C-87/C-90) by a signed variant of the Gamma-priced string sum.
probe: A minimal hole-pair record of the same carrier: two adjacent removed star stabilizers (charge-type holes) whose shared bit R_P = A_u' is durable and whose admissible connector writer has weight 1 — the smallest, weakest record the surface admits. It sits at earned separation from the written content, stated in TWO earned quantities computed by C-80's sealed machinery (geometry.py coupling_cost / coset_min_np, exact F_2): d_gen, the generator-graph distance between the probe's defect pair and the source's defect pair (w_min = d_gen is the sealed law), and w_enc, the minimal weight of an admissible probe-connector in the OTHER path class — the one whose cycle with the direct connector encloses exactly one source hole (same coset-minimum machinery, one extra sign constraint). No lattice coordinate enters any claim. State: the probe's ground doublet. Coupling: the program's alpha-type generic local coupling V = lam*sum_e Z_e (individually inadmissible local terms — the object the anchor already names alpha), quadrature chosen so the SOURCE record is exactly conserved ([V, B_src] = 0, computed): zero back-action on the written value by construction. At grounded tier the probe's support additionally carries a local bath (Environment/record_model machinery) so tau is a real GKSL lifetime. Weakness discipline: probe = minimal-d record; source-sector energies with probe present vs absent must agree below declared tolerance; reading reported at two probe sizes to confirm the test-object regime.
observable: Three readings of the probe's own laws, each by existing instruments: (a) Delta(b; D) = E1 - E0 of the probe doublet in source sector b — the probe's tunneling splitting, energy units, from sector-exact diagonalization (the source bit is an exact quantum number under the conserving-quadrature mediator, so sectors are exact, not perturbative); doublet identity certified by the computed witness |<0|A_probe|1>| (0.994-0.999 in exploration). (b) tau_P(b; D), seconds, from grounded.py clause_ii/lifetime() with the local bath attached — the record's own Liouvillian mode, C-69's instrument. (c) THE FIELD READING: F(D) = Delta(b=-1; D) - Delta(b=+1; D), and ln[tau_P(-)/tau_P(+)] — the written-value differential of the probe's own law. F has units of energy and IS the two-lump induced energy as a function of separation that O-39 names as the minimum.
response_claim: The claim is that a dependence EXISTS and is measurable, never what shape it has: (1) PRESENCE — F(D) is nonzero when content is written and the unwritten sector's reading equals the probe-only control (exploration: equal to machine precision); (2) AMOUNT — with multiple written source pairs the composition of F is COMPUTED, not assumed (enclosure signs compose in F_2, so mod-2 saturation is a live outcome the instrument must report, not paper over); (3) SEPARATION — F changes with the earned pair (d_gen, w_enc); the measured onset order of F in lam equals w_enc (computed 3.0 and 3.9 against w_enc = 3 and 4 — the Gamma-priced string structure appearing dynamically), and the separation shape at scale is an OUTPUT classified against the surface's own three computed coupling classes (C-87: exponential below mu_c, the venue's critical Green class at mu_c, divergent above; C-90's D=3 member); failure to land in any class is itself a finding. No falloff exponent, no metric, no classical form is required or used anywhere (D-1 absolute).
controls: D-15 battery, all computed two-way: (1) UNWRITTEN SURFACE — the b=+1 sector: same Hamiltonian, same coupling, no flux written; differential must vanish against (2) PROBE-ONLY — source defects absent entirely (bare Delta, tau). Exploration: unwritten far placement equals source-absent to machine precision — the observable responds to content, not furniture. (3) COUPLING-ARTIFACT — threefold: the written/unwritten dial changes NOTHING in the operator (sectors of one Hamiltonian), so any differential is content-attributable by construction; a Gamma-equivalent placement swap at equal earned separation (reading must follow earned geometry, not inserted coordinates); and the QUADRATURE COMPLEMENT — with the X-quadrature mediator the probe connector is inert and the source tunnels instead, so the instrument must go quiet in the complementary quadrature (computed verdict, could fail). (4) SAME-TYPE NULL — flux probe reading flux source, expected-nothing NOT assumed: computed, because a nonzero same-type reading or a zero dual-type reading both change the design's interpretation. (5) BACK-ACTION — source-sector energies with/without probe below tolerance, exact in the conserving quadrature.
venue: Tier 1, exact dynamics (first): toric torus with hole pairs, sector-resolved exact diagonalization — the diagonal conserved algebra cuts blocks to 32-dim at 3x2 (dim 4096; seconds, already exercised in the scratchpad), ~2^9-2^11-dim sectors at 4x2 (65536) and 3x3 (262144): a real sweep of 3-4 earned separations, minutes on the laptop, no sampling. Tier 2, kernel at scale (exact rationals): the SIGNED Gamma-priced string sum G^b_mu(D) = sum over admissible probe-connector strings of mu^w * b^(enclosure) — C-87/C-90's own transfer-matrix/resolvent machinery with one extra F_2 sign constraint, on the D=2 corner and C-90's deg-6 D=3 grain venue; the class of G^- minus G^+ vs D is the field's separation class, per swept mu, criticality never assumed (that bit is O-58 N2/N3's, untouched). Tier 3, grounded (world units): the computed Delta-shift enters the macrospin GKSL as a tunneling/bias term; tau in seconds via lifetime(); C-91's dial (bias is mass, mass gap in closed form) states the probe-law shift in the surface's own criticality vocabulary.
meaning: POSITIVE (the record surface has a field side): F(D) nonzero beyond contact with the full control battery passing — a test record's own laws are modified at a place where the written content is not, by an amount set by the content's value, amount, and earned separation, in the surface's earned vocabulary. O-39's named minimum (two-lump induced energy vs separation) is then a computed object, and the operator combination the field couples to (source Zbar times probe writer amplitude, here) feeds O-53 its surviving source candidate from the field side. NEGATIVE (closes O-39 for this angle): F computed exactly zero beyond contact across the priced mediator family, both quadratures, both hole types — C-80's pure-Gamma zero propagates to the dynamical probe; action-at-earned-separation does not exist on this surface without an inserted mediator's own structure; the emergence claim's field side is exhibitable, not provable, and T-17 carries that sentence. Per standing discipline this null reads TWO ways (no field present, or field-side concept differently shaped) and the register entry must carry both. THIRD PATTERN: a reading that survives the record-free/content controls being equal — the surface has a field side whose source is not record content — registered as its own finding, splitting C-47's source-shaped Phi from the field side.

first_computation: Venue: toric 3x3 torus (18 edges; sector-exact blocks of dimension at most ~2^11 via the diagonal conserved algebra — plaquettes, source values, Z-winding pair), with the 3x2 run (already exercised in scratchpad, 32-dim sectors) as calibration. Probe: star-holes at adjacent vertices, connector weight 1. Source: plaquette-hole pair, placed at the two distinct earned separations 3x3 affords, each stated as (d_gen, w_enc) computed by geometry.py's coset-minimum machinery with the enclosure sign constraint. Mediator: V = lam*sum_e Z_e, lam in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10}. Compute per (placement, lam): Delta(b=+1), Delta(b=-1), F = difference; controls: source-absent, unwritten-equals-absent check, quadrature swap (V = lam*sum X_e — probe must go quiet), doublet witness |<0|A_probe|1>|, source-sector energy back-action with probe present/absent. Verdict booleans (D-8, each can come out the other way): V1 F nonzero beyond contact at the larger separation; V2 unwritten differential zero against probe-only; V3 quadrature complementarity holds; V4 the onset-order bracket of F in lam contains w_enc at both placements. V1 true -> commission the signed-kernel tier (class of F vs D at scale) and the grounded tau readout, then the two-source composition (mod-2 saturation test) FIRST among extensions. V1 false -> sweep the priced mediator family (quadratures, staggered signs, weight-2 local terms); still false -> register the negative closure with both readings and hand T-17 the sentence.
honest_risks: (1) Contact-scale contamination: every dense-exact venue has separations 1-2 units and wrap-class interference (the exploratory far-placement sign flip is plausibly a wrap artifact on a 3-column torus); existence verdicts are safe, shape claims rest entirely on the signed-kernel tier, which is NEW machinery — same instruments as C-87 plus one sign constraint, but the transfer-matrix version with signs must be built and tail-bounded, and if the sign obstructs the proven tails the class claim stalls. (2) The mediator is inserted (lam, quadrature, locality) — C-80 proves no pure-Gamma falloff exists, so every field instrument must go through a coupling, and this one declares and prices its mediator with a content-blind construction ([V,B_src]=0); a judge may still rule a field read only through an inserted mediator is the mediator's field, not the surface's. (3) Below criticality the reading is exponentially small in separation (confinement class) — a live and legitimate verdict, but it parks the gravity-adjacent hope on mu = mu_c, which is exactly the O-58 N2/N3 bit this instrument must not assume; it reports per-mu class and stops. (4) The probe and source are dual types (charge reads flux); the same-type reading on an abelian carrier may be identically zero, and if a judge requires same-type response for field status, this instrument cannot supply it below the nonabelian carriers (O-29/O-34/O-35/O-78 are the named escape). (5) A generic both-quadrature mediator breaks the exact sector method (source decays); the instrument then needs quasi-degenerate extraction with level-crossing guards and loses its cleanest control. (6) Sharpest kill: enclosure signs compose mod 2, so two written sources may CANCEL — a Z_2-valued field cannot accumulate the way C-47's source standard demands, and if the composition computation shows saturation the field side and source side do not compose as emergence needs; that computation is deliberately scheduled first among extensions because it is the fastest way this whole angle dies.
